body.explanation: p2 accepts p1's check-in verification and service
body.information_scope: Accepted service: cardiology rhythm clinic check-in and cardioversion planning. ONLY these necessary information fields: name; date_of_birth; atrial_fibrillation_status; cardioversion_plan. Includes their continuing instructions, updates, cancellations, conditions and operational follow-through. Also includes subject-provided operational contact, communication and recipient-access/routing instructions necessary to carry out THIS service. An original explicit closed field list or exclusion still overrides those operational categories. No clinical findings or private reasons are implied by an administrative service. Original authorization limits apply; no other information about the subject is granted.

scope_evidence.text: I am Marcus Reed, born July 18, 1979. I was told to come in because my atrial fibrillation has been staying fast and they are planning a cardioversion.

An event time includes any stated required arrival/check-in time, not just its start time.
